decision_statement: Merge pull request #4521 of claims-intake (duplicate-attachment fix) into main by squash, head 5d1c9f0, CI run 9142 green, under the production change review policy.

Hold for the month-end freeze: leaves the defect in production.
Merge without squash: keeps 14 fix-up commits in main's history.
